name: The Sea Explorer
summary: Exploring the jaw-dropping US east coast by foot and by boat
description:
This tour takes you along the breathtaking eastern coastline of the United States, combining scenic coastal hikes with unforgettable boat trips. You will explore pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and vibrant seaside towns while enjoying the relaxed rhythm of life by the ocean.
Throughout the journey, you will experience a perfect balance between adventure and comfort, with plenty of time to swim, relax, and take in the stunning natural surroundings. This tour is ideal for travelers who love the sea and want to discover the coast from both land and water.

name: The Forest Hiker
summary: Breathtaking hike through the Canadian Banff National Park
description:
This tour is a peaceful and immersive hiking experience through the heart of the Canadian Banff National Park. You will walk through dense forests, follow crystal-clear rivers, and enjoy panoramic views of majestic mountains and alpine lakes.
Designed for nature lovers of all levels, the tour offers well-paced hikes, comfortable accommodations, and plenty of opportunities to connect with nature while enjoying one of the most beautiful national parks in the world.

name: The Snow Adventurer
summary: Exciting adventure in the snow with snowboarding and skiing
description:
This high-energy winter adventure takes place in the snowy mountains of Aspen, Colorado. You will spend your days skiing, snowboarding, and exploring winter landscapes while enjoying the thrill of cold-weather sports.
The tour combines excitement and comfort, offering expert guidance, stunning alpine scenery, and cozy evenings after action-packed days in the snow. It is perfect for travelers seeking adrenaline and unforgettable winter experiences.

name: The Park Camper
summary: Breathing in Nature in America's most spectacular National Parks
description:
This extended camping tour leads you through some of the most spectacular national parks in the United States. You will experience dramatic canyons, desert landscapes, and iconic natural landmarks while sleeping under the stars.
The journey focuses on reconnecting with nature, offering guided hikes, scenic viewpoints, and unforgettable outdoor experiences. It is ideal for adventurous travelers who want to explore America’s wild landscapes in depth.

name: The City Wanderer
summary: Living the life of Wanderlust in the US' most beatiful cities
description:
This tour allows you to experience the vibrant lifestyle of some of the most iconic cities in the United States. From New York to Los Angeles and San Francisco, you will explore diverse cultures, famous landmarks, and unique neighborhoods.
Designed for curious travelers, the tour blends sightseeing, local experiences, and free time to discover each city at your own pace. It is perfect for those who love urban exploration and cultural diversity.

name: The Sports Lover
summary: Surfing, skating, parajumping, rock climbing and more, all in one tour
description:
This action-packed tour is designed for thrill-seekers who want to experience a wide range of outdoor sports in one unforgettable journey. Activities include surfing, skating, skydiving, rock climbing, and river rafting.
Set across California’s most exciting locations, the tour challenges your limits while offering breathtaking scenery and professional guidance. It is ideal for adventurous travelers who crave variety, adrenaline, and physical challenges.

name: The Star Gazer
summary: The most remote and stunningly beautiful places for seeing the night sky
description:
This tour takes you to some of the most remote and stunning locations in the United States, carefully chosen for their exceptionally clear night skies. You will witness breathtaking views of stars, planets, and the Milky Way far from city lights.
During the day, you will explore unique natural landscapes, while evenings are dedicated to peaceful stargazing experiences. This tour is perfect for travelers seeking tranquility, beauty, and a deeper connection with the universe.

name: The Northern Lights
summary: Enjoy the Northern Lights in one of the best places in the world
description:
This short but unforgettable tour offers the chance to witness the magical Northern Lights in one of the best locations on Earth. Based in Yellowknife, you will experience the beauty of the Arctic night sky under ideal viewing conditions.
The tour is designed to be comfortable and accessible, combining expert guidance with breathtaking natural phenomena. It is perfect for travelers who dream of seeing the aurora borealis at least once in their lifetime.

name: The Wine Taster
summary: Exquisite wines, scenic views, exclusive barrel tastings,  and much more
description:
This relaxing tour takes you through California’s famous wine country, where you will enjoy exquisite wines, scenic vineyard views, and exclusive tastings. You will visit renowned wineries and learn about the art of winemaking from local experts.
The journey offers a perfect mix of luxury and leisure, making it ideal for travelers who appreciate fine wine, beautiful landscapes, and refined culinary experiences.
